summary.text: Janet Dudding is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Paul Dyson and Libertarian Jeff Miller.
A CPA and former governmental auditor, she has said she is running on ethics, integrity and accountability.

paragraphs.text: Janet Dudding earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of Southern Mississippi and an M.B.A. from Millsaps College.
Her career experience includes working as a governmental auditor, an accountant and an investigator.
Dudding won the Democratic primary for Texas House District 14 in 2020 and lost the general election to incumbent Republican John Raney, 57.5 percent to 42.5 percent.
She won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for the same seat, defeating David Kessler with 67.3 percent of the vote.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described a background in governmental policy, accounting and oversight, and listed affordability and healthcare, raising the minimum wage and local control over data center growth among her priorities.
